name: Aphoristic quotes credited to a deity

name: The ideal and idealism word family
description: Fires on 'ideal', 'ideally', 'idealism' and 'idealists', usually in political or philosophical remarks.

name: Madden Ultimate Team builder links
description: Activates on Muthead 'team-builder' URLs and roster/design talk for the Madden Ultimate Team game.

name: mixed or low-signal feature
description: Tokens and examples span unrelated topics — earthquakes, school, skincare — with no shared linguistic theme.

name: Makeup highlighters and reseller prices
description: Fires on cosmetics names (e.g. NARS Albatross) and reseller stock/price chatter such as 'raised prices' and 'kilos'.

name: The word 'adult' across varied contexts
description: Activates on the token 'adult' in unrelated phrases — adult cakes, adult babies, AdultSwim.

name: Love of knowledge and lifelong learning
description: Fires on reflections about knowledge, learning and intellectual humility, e.g. 'the more I learn, the more I realize how much I don't know'.
